info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Loan By Param1-spec
info.description: The Loan Products Retrieval API allows users to fetch detailed information about specific loan products based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is designed for developers seeking to access loan product data for applications in financial services or personal finance management. Typical consumers include banking applications, loan comparison tools, and customer support systems. By using this API, developers can enhance their applications with accurate loan information tailored to user needs.

get.summary: Retrieve loan product details by ID.
get.description: Fetches the details of a specific loan product identified by its unique ID. This endpoint returns all relevant information related to the loan product, including criteria, terms, and conditions, which can help users make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching specific loan product details based on the provided loan product ID. This endpoint retrieves information such as interest rates, terms, and conditions related to the specified loan product.

GetLoanByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on loan products, specifically identified by LOAN-500045. It is expected to contain a JSON string payload.
